title: Radar Algorithm Engineer – Data Fusion
description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role As Radar Algorithm Engineer, you will own radar performance for our counter-UAV systems, from detection and tracking algorithms to the answers Product needs on what each radar can do. You become the in-house reference on radar within the Data Fusion team. You will split your time between algorithm work and analysis in Paris and field test campaigns, with the chance to build a radar team that grows around you. Responsibilities Develop and improve radar detection and tracking algorithms, including tracker tuning for real-world conditions. Analyze recorded radar data against ground truth to measure and improve end-to-end performance. Own the software integration of new radar models, through to their field test campaigns. Define explainable performance metrics (detection range, target size, altitude, scenario) for counter-UAV concepts of operations. Characterize radar cross-section behavior of representative targets and translate it into expected detection performance. Develop radar-based navigation capabilities for GNSS-denied environments and fuse radar with optronic sensors. Act as the go-to radar expert for Product and neighboring teams, turning results into settings and guidance they can use. Candidate Requirements MSc or PhD in applied mathematics, signal processing, robotics, or a related field. Hands-on experience with Kalman filtering and multi-target tracking, taken from algorithm to code validated on real data. Strong mathematical foundations and solid coding skills, with estimation or tracking code that has run on a real system. Knowledge of radar fundamentals and experience with drones are a plus. Eagerness to work in the field: regular test campaigns and willingness to travel internationally to demos and customer sites. Humble and intellectually honest, with a habit of questioning your own results. Fluency in English required; French is a plus.
